description: This file defines the InputStream class, which extends NativeResource, and provides methods for stream input operations such as reading, seeking, and checking EOF status. It appears to be an integral part of the input/output handling in the AWS CRT PHP SDK, particularly for handling stream data sources.

classes.name: InputStream
classes.description: A class encapsulating input stream operations, allowing reading, seeking, and EOF checking on a stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InputStream object with a PHP stream and sets up native options.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases resources upon destruction of the object.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, either a specified length or the full length.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream relative to a basis.
